status: Draft for engineering and counsel review. Entity and field names are proposals for build plan B2; the templates' field names are unchanged.

types.long_text: Free text of one or more sentences, entered by a person.
types.identifier: A reference or registration number, stored exactly as given.
types.date: Calendar date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Rendered in the document's date style.
types.time: Time of day with time zone, ISO 8601 (HH:MM±HH:MM).
types.money: { amount, currency }: amount is a decimal string, currency an ISO 4217 code. Never a float.
types.rate: Decimal string holding a fraction ("0.02" is 2%). Rendered as a percentage.
types.share_count: Whole number of shares. Rendered with thousands separators.
types.country: Country name as it should appear in the document. ISO 3166 code stored alongside.
types.jurisdiction: Place of incorporation or formation, which may be below country level (e.g. Delaware, United States).
types.boolean: true or false. Used only in conditions.
types.enum: One of the listed values. Printed with its label from `labels`, or with underscores as spaces (decision 0011).

origins.record: Entered on the sponsor's forms (build plan B4) and stored on the source entity. Validated when saved.
origins.document: Entered when the document is created, and stored with the DocumentInstance inputs.
origins.calculated: Computed by the calculation service from other records. Never typed, never produced by a model.
origins.derived: Worked out by the platform from other fields by a fixed rule (not a financial figure).
origins.platform: Set by the platform itself: content hashes, identity references, links to other documents.
origins.external: Taken from a verified third-party record (for example the administrator's bank details).
origins.execution: Known only when the document is signed or accepted. Left blank at assembly; filled in the signature slice.

entities.Sponsor: Not yet in the data model. The sponsor (GP) and its affiliates. See README gap G1.
entities.PortfolioTerms: Addendum §3.1. Versioned terms of a portfolio.
entities.Offer: Addendum §3.1. One offering round for a portfolio.
entities.Party: Base spec §5.1, via the identity stub (build plan B1). An investor.
entities.SubscriptionRequest: Addendum §3.1. An investor's application to one portfolio.
entities.Allocation: Addendum §3.1. Amount accepted and shares to issue.
entities.SubscriptionAccount: Not yet in the data model. The administrator's verified receiving account for a portfolio. See README gap G2.
entities.CostAllocationRule: Addendum §3.1. How SPC-level costs are split across portfolios.
entities.DocumentInstance: Base spec §5.1. Inputs entered when a document is created, and links to other documents.
entities.DraftVersion: Base spec §5.1. An immutable version of a document (INV-3).
entities.Signature: Signature slice (DF-40 to DF-42). Not built in this slice; these fields are blank at assembly.

meeting.attendees.description: Directors present at the meeting; a subset of umbrella.directors.

investor.authorised_signatories.description: People who sign for an entity investor.

investor.controllers.description: Authorised signatories and beneficial owners of an entity investor.

issuer_description.description: Factual description of the issuer's business, products and stage, from uploaded sources only. Maximum 200 words.

project_risk_factors.description: Risks specific to this investment and issuer, from uploaded sources only. No statements about returns, liquidity or exit. Maximum 250 words.

umbrella.legal_name.description: SPC's legal name, including “Segregated Portfolio Company” or “SPC”

umbrella.fund_category.description: Regulatory category, e.g. private investment fund
umbrella.fund_category.notes: Value list to confirm with BVI counsel.

umbrella.is_regulated_fund.description: Whether the Company is a regulated fund (FSC prior approval to create a portfolio) or not (FSC notification within 14 days)
umbrella.is_regulated_fund.notes: Could be derived from fund_category once counsel confirms the mapping.

umbrella.investor_basis_description.description: Investor basis relied on, in words

umbrella.om_date.notes: Comes from the imported U2 once U2 import exists.

umbrella.om_requires_related_party_conse.description: Whether the offering memorandum requires investor or advisory-committee consent to related-party acquisitions

umbrella.related_party_consent_clause.description: Offering memorandum clause requiring related-party consent

umbrella.cost_rule_ref.notes: The rule in force on the document date.

umbrella.subscription_terms_hash.description: Content hash of the cleared subscription terms

director.is_interested.description: Whether the director has declared an interest in this transaction
director.is_interested.notes: Per transaction, not a property of the director.

director.abstains.description: Whether an interested director abstains from voting

company_signatory.name.notes: Which signatory is used is chosen when the document is created. See README gap G5.

portfolio.share_class_name.description: Name of the portfolio's share class

portfolio.allocation_method_description.description: How oversubscription is allocated, in words
portfolio.allocation_method_description.notes: Wording is inserted after “allocations be made”, so it must read as an adverbial phrase, e.g. “pro rata to the amounts applied for”.

portfolio.supplement_number.description: Supplement number under the offering memorandum

portfolio.supplement_hash.description: Content hash of the cleared supplement

portfolio.fee_basis.description: What the management fee is charged on
portfolio.fee_basis.notes: Inserted after “a year on”, e.g. “the aggregate subscribed capital of the Portfolio”.

portfolio.has_hurdle.description: Whether the performance fee has a hurdle

portfolio.costs_deducted_on_lapse.description: Whether capped costs are deducted from refunds if the round never closes

portfolio.lapse_cost_cap.description: Cap on costs deducted if the offer lapses

portfolio.minimum_close_amount.description: Minimum raised for the portfolio to proceed
portfolio.minimum_close_amount.notes: Not in the addendum's Offer fields yet.

portfolio.funding_deadline.notes: Not in the addendum's Offer fields yet.

asset.issuer_name.description: Legal name of the company invested in

asset.instrument.description: Class of shares bought, e.g. “Series B preferred shares”

asset.acquisition_source.description: Where the portfolio acquires the asset; gp_sourced triggers the conflict controls (addendum §5)

asset.max_quantity.description: Maximum number of shares to buy

asset.price_per_share.description: Price the portfolio pays per share

asset.seller_name.notes: For a primary round the seller is the issuer. See README gap G8.

asset.long_stop_date.description: Date by which the financing round must close

asset.sponsor_cost_per_share.description: Sponsor affiliate's cost per share (evidence required)
asset.sponsor_cost_per_share.validation: Required when acquisition_source is gp_sourced; must link to evidence in SVC-EVID.

asset.sponsor_acquisition_date.description: Date the sponsor affiliate acquired the shares

asset.markup_pct.description: Transfer price over sponsor's cost, as a percentage

asset.sponsor_retains_shares.description: Whether the sponsor keeps part of its holding directly

asset.valuation_range.description: Valuer's value or range per share
asset.valuation_range.notes: Entered from the valuation report, not calculated.

asset.transfer_restrictions.notes: Extracted from issuer documents in a later slice (LRA-07); typed in for now.

asset.consent_status.description: Status of issuer consent / ROFR waiver

asset.completion_window_days.description: Days after the offer closes to complete secondary purchases

asset.has_placement_fee.description: Whether a fee is paid to an intermediary for sourcing the shares

investor.type.description: Individual or entity; selects wording and signature blocks

investor.is_trustee.description: Whether the entity invests as trustee of a trust

investor.kyc_completed_date.notes: Held by the identity module; read-only in this slice.

investor.formed_for_investment.description: Whether the entity was formed to invest in this portfolio (look-through for investor-count limits)
investor.formed_for_investment.notes: Specific to the portfolio, so held on the subscription, not the party.

investor.status_selected.notes: The investor's own confirmation. The platform does not determine eligibility.

investor.existing_portfolio_name.notes: Names another portfolio on purpose. See README gap G3 (INV-10).

investor.prior_agreement_date.description: Date of the earlier subscription agreement

investor.changes_since_prior.description: Changes to details since the earlier agreement

subscription.allocated_amount.notes: Typed in during this slice (build plan B4) until the allocation engine (DF-65) exists.

payment.reference.notes: Issued by the administrator per investor.

resolution.date.notes: For written resolutions this may be the date the last director signs. See README gap G6.

resolution.interest_declared.description: Whether any director present has declared an interest
resolution.interest_declared.notes: True when any director interest entered for the document has is_interested.

resolution.effective_date_differs.description: Whether the effective date is later than signing

conflict_disclosure.date.description: Date of the conflict disclosure statement
conflict_disclosure.date.notes: D15 is not in this slice. See README gap G4.
